svg.title: VI. The Lovers: watt
svg.desc: VI. The Lovers, upright. Software. Modern CPU frequency and power management utility for Linux.. Artwork from scanned Gustave Doré Inferno engravings, first published in 1861.

g.desc: Gustave Doré, Inferno (1861), In its leaves that day we read no more. https://archive.org/details/dantesinferno00dantuoft; scan leaf 91. Public domain: nineteenth-century engravings; Doré died in 1883. The digitizing collection records NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT.
